d: In 1860, workmen digging a drainage ditch in a Scottish hamlet discover the Towie Ball, a strange and beautiful black stone object about three inches in diameter. It has been painstakingly carved into a bulbous shape from a single block of rock.

A grim discovery in a Swedish lake reveals shocking ancient practices. In the Canadian Arctic, the fossil of a previously unknown mammal is found. Bizarre ice formations in the Antarctic Ocean are investigated.

Human remains are discovered high in the Ecuadorian Andes. In Norway, an archaeology student unearths metal artefacts. A strange earthquake-like event is investigated in Canada. In Greenland, a Viking longhouse with a unique history is found.

In Russia, 34,000-year-old graves are discovered. A team attempts to locate a World War II British plane that went missing in Iceland. Fossils are found in an Alaskan riverbank. In Antarctica an undiscovered depression in the ice is investigated.

A volcanic island off the coast of Antarctica with a mysterious past is explored. In the Peruvian Andes, the mummified remains of a teenage girl are discovered. A shipwreck is found near Russia's Franz Josef Archipelago.
Mysterious industrial waste and abandoned homes are discovered in a remote, uninhabited part of Greenland. In Norway, strange ditches and huge mounds are found deep within the Arctic Circle.

A Kazakh farmer discovers ancient burial sites that may determine whether or not the legend of the Amazon women warriors is myth or reality. In the Italian Alps, a group of hikers explore long forgotten military infrastructure.

A secret military base is discovered a few hundred miles from the North Pole. A man-made, ancient stone formation is found 120 feet below the surface of Lake Huron. A 1500 year old burial ground is discovered on the shores of the Baltic Sea.
